properties.displayName: Demo environment - enforce maximum resource expiration window
properties.description: Denies resources whose ExpirationDate tag is set further in the future than the maximum allowed resource lifetime (default 5 calendar days). Requires the ExpirationDate tag to be present in ISO 8601 date format (e.g. 2026-08-29). Implements TR-005 (Resource expiration and teardown governance) and the BRD requirement that no resource may remain active for 5 calendar days or longer without an approved exception.

metadata.description: Enable or disable execution of this policy
The maximum allowed duration between resource creation and the declared ExpirationDate tag value. Default is P5D (5 calendar days) per BRD requirement.
